Read an older provenance record as a receipt

Source: R/crt_receipt_migrate.R
crt_receipt_migrate.Rd

Reads a manifest.json or provenance.json written before its package moved to receipts, through the receipt mapping table (inst/extdata/receipt/mapping.csv), so existing records stay readable in the receipt's keys while writers converge forward, each when it is next touched (crate#43).

Usage

crt_receipt_migrate(
  x,
  format,
  section = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  time = NULL,
  path = NULL
)

Arguments

x

Path to the record, or the record as a list from jsonlite::read_json().

format

The record's format; see Formats.

section

For a record holding several outputs: the path to one, its parts separated by /.

name

The output's name, when the record carries none. Defaults to section for a section of a record.

time

UTC time in ISO 8601 with a trailing Z, when the record carries none.

path

Optional: where to write the receipt, a file or a directory (which gets receipt.json). It is written as crt_receipt_write() writes, canonical JSON pretty-printed, so crt_receipt_read() reads it back to the same bytes.

Value

A receipt, as a list, invisibly when path is given. Compare it with crt_receipt_compare().

Details

A migrated receipt has no recipe identity: an older record lacks fields a recipe needs (resolved settings, a seed, inputs' own ids), so recipe.recipe_id is null, output.migrated_from names the format, and crt_receipt_compare() reports its recipe as unknown. Fields the mapping places nowhere are kept verbatim in context.legacy, keyed by their path in the record. Fields the mapping does not know at all go there too, and are reported with a warning of class crate_receipt_unmapped, so nothing is dropped silently.

Formats

  • "link manifest.json": link's export manifest.

  • "floodplains provenance.json": one section of floodplains' per-area record, named by section, such as "floodplain/all_ff02" or "network/CO3".

The mapping table also lists STAC's keys (file:checksum, file:size, processing:software, processing:datetime) beside the receipt keys they mirror.

Examples

rec <- system.file("extdata", "receipt", "examples", "legacy", "link_manifest.json",
                   package = "crate")
r <- crt_receipt_migrate(rec, "link manifest.json")
r$recipe$code
#> $link
#> $link$version
#> [1] "0.31.2"
#> 
#> $link$commit
#> [1] "a9b8c7d6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b0"
#> 
#> $link$dirty
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#>
